samples.body: ok I need to vent for a sec. had a guy no show today for a 6 hour back piece. SIX HOURS. I turned down two walk ins and a cover up for this. he messages me at 3pm "sorry something came up can we do next week" and then gets mad when I tell him the deposit is gone. dude thats what the deposit is FOR. I spent all weekend on that drawing, I printed the stencil, I set up the station. you dont get to act like Im the bad guy for having a policy that is written in like 4 places. anyway Tyler bought me tacos and I re did my flash binder so the day wasnt totally wasted. if you book with an artist and you cant make it just TELL THEM a couple days ahead, most of us are pretty chill about it if you give us a heads up. rant over

10 years tattooing this month. kinda crazy. I started apprenticing at a street shop on Colfax when I was 26 and broke and my mentor made me scrub tubes for like 5 months before I was allowed to touch a machine. hated it at the time, get it now. I wanna say thank you to everybody who sat for me when my lines were wobbly lol you know who you are. and to Tyler for going in on Salt & Sparrow with me even though we had no idea how to run a business (still dont some days). love yall. gonna go eat a whole pizza

PSA cause I keep getting asked this. no I will not copy another artists tattoo off pinterest. I'll do something in that style, I'll do something with the same vibe, but I'm not tracing somebody elses work and putting it on you. that person drew that, it's theirs, and also you deserve your own thing?? bring me the reference and we'll make it yours. it's not me being snobby its just like the one rule in this whole industry that everybody kind of agrees on. ok thank you goodnight

whoever keeps parking in our loading spot behind the shop with the green subaru, I'm begging you. I had a box of 40 ink bottles and nowhere to stop. there are literally signs. I'm not gonna get you towed but I'm thinking about it real hard. like REAL hard. ask around
